_note: P1 新增系统委托模板 23 条（李白，SGODOT-281/284；方案 §9.6）。形状照 #212 的 RequestTemplate：type 为 output / regional / explore / together，climate 首字母大写与 profile.climate 一致，text 为委托卡两句文案。enabled:false 的有两种：①type 为 regional / explore / together，按 #212 等旅行上线再开；②need 需要 #212 Need 还不支持的条件，完整意图写在 p1_need（family 族、where 塘类型或外城、trail Trail 菜、scale 量 ×1.5、regional zone/city/other_zone、max_rarity、visit 签到、floor 不回收材料的委托地板价），引擎支持后去掉 p1_need 并打开。board 是该模板上哪块板；放进 requests.boards 的列表由苏烈在主文件里改（数组片段不追加）。 苏烈 (SGODOT-284): the engine now also takes need.family (Orchard Basket), a list of styles (Packed Lunches) and scale (Wholesale Order, Fish Market Crate), so those four are on; board is not a template field — the ids are listed in p0_content.json requests.boards (a list without ids cannot be appended by a fragment). Regional and Stamp Run are on (苏烈, SGODOT-284): a regional template draws only once one of its items can be got (a regional seed on sale, a regional fish in a pond), so the farm and fishing lines open them by their data; Stamp Run checks in at another outpost of the home city. River Run names Rainbow Trout (李白 q(109): the only Fine fish found only in River). Cross-city on (苏烈, 李白 q(128)): Tea Trail (a Trip 1–2 city's first Tea House, Homestead Lv2), Postcard Trip (a Trip 2–3 city's Market Square 1) and New Climate (the nearest city in another climate zone, its Market Square 1) check in there — a small city's Trading Post cabin when it has no such room — and are handed in at the home Market Board like Stamp Run; the check-in counts that city's Deliveries. Far Pond takes the kinds of fish landed in another city since it was taken (a kind caught at home too counts the same); it is gated at Homestead Lv2 as the other explore templates (a gate list is any-of: Fishing Lv2 alone put it on the first session's Market Board, §14). Still off: Harvest Together (live rooms). Stamp Run is gated at Homestead Lv2 (as Postcard Trip) so the first session's Market Board stays as §14 has it; 李白 to confirm.
